summary.text: Emmanuel Findlay Jr. is the Conservative Party candidate for Assembly District 79. Ballotpedia lists him as a candidate for New York City Council District 16 in 2025 on the Republican and Conservative lines and for this Assembly seat in 2024 on the Conservative line; he lost both races.

paragraphs.text: In the November 2025 general election for New York City Council District 16, Findlay received 11.4% of the vote (2,357 votes) running on the Republican and Conservative Party lines, losing to incumbent Althea Stevens.
In the November 2024 general election for this Assembly seat, Findlay received 3.3% of the vote (841 votes) on the Conservative Party line, behind Chantel Jackson (D) and Sharon Darby (R).
Appears on the November 3, 2026 ballot on the Conservative Party line only; he withdrew from the Republican primary and advanced from the Conservative Party primary without appearing on the ballot.
